calc_note: Prices are Gamma's yearly billing prices, the default view of its pricing page; monthly billing costs more and is not shown here. Free is not in the calculator: its 400 credits come once at signup and do not refill.

after_plans: Prices are billed yearly: $108 a year for Plus, $216 for Pro and $1,080 for Ultra. Gamma says annual billing saves up to 28% compared to monthly billing. Unused credits roll over up to 2 times the monthly amount, and paid users can buy more credits. On individual plans each extra member is charged as a seat. Business plans (10,000 credits per seat a month) are on a separate tab. Taxes may apply.

faq: Free is $0. Billed yearly, Plus is $9/month ($108 a year), Pro is $18/month ($216 a year) and Ultra is $90/month ($1,080 a year). Gamma says yearly billing saves up to 28% compared to monthly billing.

Credits are used for AI features throughout Gamma. The number an action uses depends on what you are doing, which AI model is used and the length or complexity of the generation. Plus includes 1,500 a month, Pro 4,000 and Ultra 20,000.
Do unused Gamma credits roll over?
Yes, up to 2 times the monthly amount. For example, Plus can hold up to 3,000 credits.
Yes. The Free plan includes 400 credits at signup that do not refill, up to 10 slides per prompt, and export to PDF, PPTX, PNG and Google Slides.
